Convert raw sensor readings to physical values

Source: R/calibrate_sensors.R
calibrate_sensors.Rd

Converts each detection's sensor_raw to sensor_value and sensor_unit with the calibration of its transmitter: sensor_value = sensor_intercept + sensor_slope * sensor_raw. The calibration is read from the animals and tags table of x (columns sensor_slope, sensor_intercept and sensor_unit) and, for transmitters it does not calibrate, from specs, such as the result of read_tag_specs().

Usage

calibrate_sensors(x, specs = NULL, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A detset.

specs

Optional data frame with transmitter, sensor_slope, sensor_intercept and sensor_unit, and optionally sensor_type, one row per transmitter.

overwrite

If TRUE, readings that already have a sensor_value are recomputed when their transmitter has a calibration.

Value

x with sensor_value and sensor_unit filled where a calibration exists, and one log record.

Details

A reading is left as it is, and counted, when its transmitter has no calibration, when the calibration has no unit, when the reading is not a whole count of zero or more (it looks calibrated already, and a warning says so), or when the reading already has a sensor_value, as OTN extracts carry for tags whose specification OTN holds. overwrite = TRUE recomputes those values from sensor_raw. No detection is removed. The log records the readings by outcome and the transmitters with readings but no calibration.

Calibrations taken from specs are also written into the animals table, for transmitters it lists, so that the table records what was used. So is the sensor type of a transmitter with no calibration, such as a predation tag, so that detect_mortality() knows what the sensor is.

See also

read_tag_specs(), detset_log()

Examples

study <- detqc_example
dets <- detset(study$detections, study$deployments, study$animals)
specs <- read_tag_specs(system.file("extdata", "stoney_tag_specs.csv",
                                    package = "detqc"))
dets <- calibrate_sensors(dets, specs)
writeLines(strwrap(detset_log(dets)$reason[2], width = 72))
#> 1,736 of 1,736 raw sensor readings calibrated (0 with a calibration
#> from specs); kept, with a sensor_value already: 0; with a calibration
#> but no unit: 0; with no calibration: 0 (0 transmitters); not whole
#> counts of zero or more, so not calibrated: 0; sensor_value left NA
#> where not calibrated
summary(dets$detections$sensor_value[dets$detections$sensor_unit %in% "m"])
#>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#>  0.3006  1.6542  1.6542  1.9617  1.6542 10.6782
